summary: [Dashboard] Exhibitor Analytics — Count, Completion, Login, Engagement & Profile Performance (R2-R5, R15)
text: An Exhibitor Analytics dashboard page was delivered, giving organisers visibility into exhibitor counts, profile completion, logins, engagement, and profile performance over time. An Exhibitor Analytics page now charts exhibitor count by tier over time, profile-completion status with KPI cards and drill-down, login tracking, and engagement/profile-performance metrics (PRD R2-R5, R15).

summary: [Dashboard] Attendee Analytics — Count, Profile Completion & Engagement (R6, R7)
text: An Attendee Analytics dashboard page was delivered, surfacing attendee counts, profile completion, and engagement trends for organisers. An Attendee Analytics page now shows attendee count and profile completion with KPI cards plus an engagement/login dual-line chart, correctly excluding exhibitor categories and team-member logins (PRD R6, R7).

summary: [Dashboard] Platform Performance — Logins, Active Users, Favourites, Page Visits & Engagement (R8-R11, R16)
text: A Platform Performance dashboard was delivered covering logins, active users, favourites, page visits, and engagement across the whole platform. A Platform Performance page now shows web/app login activity with KPI cards, active users over time, favourites analytics with drill-down, and multi-page visit trends (PRD R8-R11, R16).

summary: [Dashboard] Mobile App — Downloads, Logins, Adoption & App Page Visits (R12)
text: A Mobile App analytics dashboard was delivered, tracking downloads, logins, adoption, and in-app page visits across iOS and Android. A Mobile App page now shows iOS vs Android downloads over time, login/adoption KPI cards with defined exhibitor and attendee app-login metrics, and an app page-visits table (PRD R12).

summary: [Dashboard] Connections Deep Dive — Meetings & Messaging Analytics (R13, R14)
text: A Connections Deep Dive dashboard was delivered, giving organisers detailed meetings and messaging analytics for their event. A Connections Deep Dive page now charts meeting status over time with KPI cards and exhibitor volume bands, plus messaging analytics (one- vs bi-directional) with drill-down (PRD R13, R14).

summary: [Dashboard] Sessions Deep Dive — Top Sessions & Session Types (R17)
text: A Sessions Deep Dive dashboard was delivered, ranking top sessions and session types by engagement for organisers. A Sessions Deep Dive page now shows a Top-20 sessions ranked table and Top-5 session types by engagement, with filtering, sorting, and drill-down to session detail (PRD R17).

summary: [Dashboard] [Splited: 4 dashboards] [Attendee Analytics, Connections Deep Dive, Logins, Session Duration] UX/UI new Event Reporting dashboards are embedded as a new sub-section under the existing Analytics module
text: The new Event Reporting dashboards were embedded as a dedicated sub-section under the existing Analytics module in the organiser admin panel, delivering the UX/UI integration for multiple dashboards. Not Clearly Specified (story is in testing; the dashboards — including Attendee Analytics, Connections Deep Dive, Logins, and Session Duration — are being embedded as a new Analytics sub-section in the left navigation, with several dashboards still at POC/awaiting-data stage).

summary: [Dashboard] [/Splitted : Part 2] UX/UI new Event Reporting dashboards are embedded as a new sub-section under the existing Analytics module
text: Six more automated Event Reporting dashboards (Exhibitor Analytics, Platform Performance, Mobile App, and more) were added as an Analytics sub-section. Six additional Embeddable.com dashboards were embedded as a new sub-section under the existing Analytics module, sitting alongside (not replacing) the current analytics pages in the organiser admin navigation.

summary: [Dashboard] Products Deep Dive — Categories, Top Products & Listing Metrics (R18)
text: A Products Deep Dive dashboard was delivered (currently in testing) covering product categories, top products, and listing metrics for organisers. A Products Deep Dive page provides Top-20 categories and Top-20 products ranked tables plus product KPI cards with filtering and drill-down (PRD R18); the story is in testing.

summary: [Dashboard] Sponsorships Deep Dive — Sponsor Performance by Asset (R21)
text: A Sponsorships Deep Dive dashboard was delivered (currently in testing), reporting sponsor performance by asset type for organisers. A Sponsorships Deep Dive page provides a per-sponsor/asset performance table (views, clicks, CTR) and sponsor KPI cards, with logic to filter to confirmed sponsors only (PRD R21); the story is in testing.

summary: Address Informa Analytics Display Feedback #2 (graph-level fixes & additions)
text: A second round of Informa-requested analytics fixes sharpens the reporting dashboards organizers use to prove event value. Graph-level fixes and additions across the analytics display (exhibitor, attendee, app/platform).

summary: Attendance: Organizer can compare Check-ins across co-located Events and view Crossover Check-ins in Total Check-In / Check-Out graph
text: Check-in analytics include badges from other EP events and unidentified external badges, with a new Event filter on each chart. Organisers see totals matching the export and can compare check-ins by badge origin across co-located events.

summary: Check-in Analytics refresh. Analytics page
text: Built a Check-in Analytics page with registration split before and after event start, total check-ins and check-outs by day or hour, and user and zone filters. Organisers see check-in and check-out charts in event time, covering internal and external registrations, filterable by role, category and zone.

summary: Check-in Analytics refresh. Checkin list page
text: Rebuilt the admin check-in list page as a table of participants by date showing first and last check-in/out per day, with filters, search and report export. Admins see each participant's daily check-in and check-out actions, expandable per cell, filter by participant fields and check-in zone, and export a report.

summary: Chech-in Analytics refresh. Checkin Zones page
text: Redesigned the Check-in zones page in check-in analytics, with zone cards, colour tags, custom and floor-plan zones, and conference hall/room marking. Admins add, remove and retype check-in zones synced with the floor plan, and zone statistics are kept if a zone is removed and restored.

summary: Check-in module | Design changes
text: Adjusted the new-UI check-in list and check-in zones pages: page sizes, row heights, pinned column, card layout, sorting, zone order and background colour. The check-in list defaults to 96 people per page with tighter layout, and zone cards sort by most check-ins in a fixed zone-type order.

summary: Custom Check-in reports exportable in ExpoPlatform
text: Built a customisable Check-in report export with system and flagged custom fields, plus unique versus duplicate scan columns. Organisers export a single-tab check-in report under Import/Export, choosing columns and filtering first-time scans from duplicates.

summary: Including column Scanned code in the check-in report
text: Added a Scanned code column to the check-in report. The check-in report shows the code scanned at check-in.

summary: 2 check-in reports - with the unique check-in per event and per day
text: Split the check-in export into 'Unique Check-In per Event' and 'Unique Check-ins per Day' reports, including co-located show and non-EP code check-ins. Organisers export check-ins limited to event dates with a unique flag, or per-day columns marking initial and duplicated check-ins.

summary: Indentifying the uniqueness of check-in for non-EP users
text: Identified unique check-ins for people not in the platform by the scanned code, and for registered users by account ID. Check-in uniqueness is counted for everyone.

summary: Enhancing Check-in List Export with Session Information
text: Added optional Session ID and Session Name fields to the Check-in List export, for sessions, exhibitor events and round tables. Check-in exports, per event or per day, can show the session ID and name for each session check-in, blank where there is none.

summary: News Export
text: Added a News export to the admin Data page, producing an .xls file of articles with 15 columns including author, tags, visibility and exhibitor. Admins can export all news articles from /admin/data as an .xls file, in the language selected on the Exports page.

summary: Add the timestamp of account activation in the exports
text: Added an 'Activation Timestamp' column at the end of the user export, recording when an account was activated by link or API in the event time zone. Exports show each user's activation time in dd-mm-yy hh:mm:ss.

summary: Need Possibility to add the 'notes' present in exhibitor profile in BO in Excel export file
text: Added a 'Notes' column and export checkbox to the Exhibitors export, carrying the Notes field from the exhibitor profile in the admin panel. The Exhibitors export includes each exhibitor's notes when 'All fields' or the 'Notes' checkbox is selected.

summary: Cancel button for exports
text: Added a cancel button so organisers can stop any export manually. Organisers can cancel a running export.

summary: Add process percentage indication for exports
Set informer "excel generation..." instead of "in progress 100%" if uploading data to excel in progress
text: Showed 'excel generation…' once export data is ready and the Excel file is being written. Users see that the Excel file is being generated.

summary: Team Member Export File - Addition of a new column "External QR"
text: Added an External QR column to the team member export. Team member exports include external QR codes.

summary: Adding a column for "is_new" field to the exhibitor export file
text: An 'Is New' column in the exhibitor export, filled yes or no from the exhibitor's 'Is New' setting. Organisers can export which exhibitors are marked new, alone or with all fields.

summary: Profile Completion Column in Export Reports (Participants)
text: The Visitor, Team member and Speaker exports gain a Profile completion column, matching what each participant sees on their dashboard. Exports show the same profile-completion value as the frontend.

summary: bySession export rework
text: Reworked the bySession report export to run via SQS, making it faster and more stable for admins downloading session data. The bySession export now runs via SQS, with the downloaded report containing all the expected session information.

summary: N+1 query loop in By Booking report (SessionOrdersRepository)
text: Fixed an N+1 query loop in the By Booking report that ran thousands of queries per page on large events, replacing it with a fixed-cost batched query. The report now runs a fixed, batched set of queries scoped to just the requested page's payment IDs, regardless of how many orders exist in the event, with identical output.

summary: Restoring Google Analytics Support: Enhancements for GA4 Integration and Validation
text: Google Analytics works again with GA4: the admin ID field validates the G- format, flags old UA IDs, and the site loads GA4 with the saved ID. Organisers track their event website in GA4; nothing loads when the ID is empty or invalid.

summary: Google Analytics field front-end validation
text: Adds front-end format validation, placeholder and help text to the Google Analytics (GA4) ID field in the Admin Panel, while still allowing an empty value to disable tracking. The GA ID input now validates the GA4 format (G-XXXXXXXXXX), shows placeholder and help text warning against duplicate GA injection, and permits an empty value to clear tracking.

summary: Exclude Customer Service Logins from "Attendee/Exhibitor Login Data" Report
text: Split 'Web' in the Visitors/Exhibitors login data report into Web and Customer service login sources. The login data report shows Customer service logins separately from genuine web logins.

summary: Additional column to Visitors/Exhibitors login
text: Added a 'Login source' column (Web, iOS, Android app) to the visitor and exhibitor login report export. The login report shows for every login attempt whether it came from the web or the iOS or Android app.

summary: Include category to the Supply&Demand graph
text: Added the product category name to the top of the Supply & Demand graph tooltip in marketplace analytics. Hovering the Supply & Demand graph shows 'Category: {name}' above participant interest, suppliers and products.

summary: Logic of displaying of how the Total meetings graph
text: Made the Total meetings graph count meetings by creation date. The graph uses one consistent date.

summary: MP || Reports for Meeting Program
text: Added a 'Generate XLS Report' button to Meeting Program details producing a multi-tab export of relevance actions, acceptances and meetings. Admins download a timestamped report with per-attendee generated, accepted, rejected and confirmed meeting counts, sponsored and free.

summary: Meeting Program report. Relevance Actions per Exhibitor tab extension
text: Added a 'Sponsored limit' column to the Relevance Actions per Exhibitor tab of the Meeting Program report. The report shows each exhibitor's sponsored meeting limit alongside their relevance actions.

summary: Meeting Program report . Relevance per Buyer&Participant tab extension
text: Extended the Meeting Program report's relevance tab to include team members and meeting sponsors, and renamed it 'Relevance per User'. The report's 'Relevance per User' tab lists relevance data for all Meeting Program user types.

summary: Meeting program. Report. All meetings tab. Add extra column about meeting generation
text: A Source column in the Meeting Program report's All Meetings tab: 1st generation, 2nd generation or Manual. Reports show whether each meeting came from the algorithm's first or second run or was added by the organiser.

summary: Meeting Program Report — Meeting Ratings in All Meetings Tab
text: The Meeting Program report's All Meetings tab shows each side's rating score, reason and 'did not take place' flag for confirmed meetings. Organisers review ratings per meeting, with empty cells where no rating was given.

summary: Enhancing Meetings report and Custom Meeting Wizard Report: Adding Business Transaction Likelihood and Meeting Did Not Take Place Columns
text: The Meetings report and Custom Meeting Wizard report gain Business Transaction Likelihood (0–10) and Meeting Did Not Take Place columns. Exports include both columns for every rated meeting, including ratings submitted before the release.

summary: To add the "parent exhibitor name" column to the "meeting-reports"
text: Added a 'Parent exhibitor name' column to the Meetings export for initiators and receivers who are child exhibitors or their team members. The Meetings report shows the parent exhibitor of each child-exhibitor participant, or leaves the cell empty when there is none.

summary: Mobile analytics MVP: Get the total logins and the total unique logged in users per app
text: Added a 'Mobile app logins' custom report in Analytics/Export: an XLS with iOS and Android tabs listing each user login with profile fields. Organisers can export logins per app, with ID, timestamp, name, email, company, job title and category, and derive total and unique logged-in users.

summary: Unique logins for the report
text: Changed the mobile app logins report to keep only each user's latest login and renamed it Unique Mobile App logins. The export lists each user once with their latest mobile login.

summary: Mobile app base stats page
text: Added an 'App data' tab to general analytics with app page views, unique badge scans and unique Android and iOS logins. Organisers see basic mobile app usage statistics in one analytics tab.

summary: Mobile analytics page
text: Replaced the admin app-data analytics page with a mobile analytics page of daily, weekly or monthly graphs for logins, page views, favourites, meetings and badge scans. Admins can see mobile app usage on the event, filtered by user group, platform and page or object, with iOS/Android totals at the top.

summary: [DS part]Create daily report to be shared with Hyve
text: Delivered the Data Science half of a click/impression reporting pipeline for Mobile App homepage elements, split from the operational-team side (EP-56995), for client Hyve. The Data Science-owned portion (data schema and pipeline for the report: date, timestamp, asset, user ID, action type, near-real-time delivery via Admin Panel export, dedup via request ID) of the joint report delivery split with EP-56995.

summary: (New Analytics) Content fixes
text: Defined the content widgets for the new analytics: counts and average daily views, adds or downloads with period change, trending topics and leaderboards. New analytics shows performance for news, sessions, on-demand, webinars and downloads, with top-content leaderboards.

summary: (New Analytics) Dashboard fixes
text: Fixed the new analytics dashboard widgets so each counts participants, exhibitors, content and actions to a defined rule based on the end date. Dashboard widgets show totals present on the end date, plus live online participants by top countries and top interest and activity categories.

summary: (New Analytics) Registration fixes
text: Defined the registration widgets for the new analytics: exhibitor, participant and team member registrations over time, by category, country, interests and activities. New analytics shows registration counts over time and breakdowns by category, country and top interest/activity categories for each audience type.

summary: Change default date range for New Analytics
text: Changed the default date range on all New Analytics pages to one month before the event start to one month after its end. New Analytics opens on a range spanning a month either side of the event, or of the earliest and latest events when several are selected.

summary: Development <first> dashboard - for demo to Informa
text: Built a first analytics dashboard for a demo: login counts, total, web and app, over time. A login analytics dashboard was ready to demo.

summary: (New Analytics UI) Meetings
text: Built the Meetings tab of the new global analytics module, with event, segment and date-range filters and web and app meeting metrics. Organisers see requested meetings by status, online and offline counts, average meeting length, time in online meetings and request sources.

summary: Check-in export: optimize database query
text: Optimised the check-in export query that ran thousands of times. Check-in exports use far fewer queries.

summary: Change the time format
text: Changed report download links across the admin panel to use the event's time zone and the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ'. Exports, imports and statistics downloads show generation time in the event time zone, with the zone named in the link text.

summary: Round tables report
text: Added a Roundtables Assigned Tables .xlsx report, one row per assigned person, via an Export Data button on each round table session page. After final schedules are sent, organisers can download a timestamped report of attendees with topic, table number, session details and invitation response.

summary: EMEA_ Add Session Id column for Favorited Session Report in Sessions
text: Added a Session ID column as the last column of the By session favourited sessions report and its export's All sessions tab. The By session report and its export show each session's ID, matching the Session ID in the sessions data export.

summary: Improve Sessions report with security concern info
text: Added 'Exhibitor event status' (including 'Rejected for security concern') and 'Offensive content reports' columns to the Sessions export. The Sessions report shows each exhibitor event's status and how many times users reported it for offensive content.

summary: Add info for Exhibitor event info
text: Added 'date of creation' and 'date of last edit' columns for exhibitor events to the Session export, logged only for exhibitor changes. The Session export shows when each exhibitor event was created and last edited by the exhibitor.

summary: [Statistics Reports] New SponsorAccountsInteractionsReport — paginated sponsor interaction rows from sponsor_statistics
text: A new sponsor-interactions report class extracts paginated sponsor engagement rows from the dedicated sponsor statistics store. New SponsorAccountsInteractionsReport class (prepare/validate/prepareQuery/resolvePaginated) hardwired to the sponsor object type, registered in ReportsList, returning sponsor interaction rows with a defined input/output contract.

summary: Standard Report generation
text: Added a Standard Report generation option to the admin Data page, triggering the Data Science team's report pipeline. Admins can generate the Standard Report prepared by the Data Science team from /admin/data like other reports.

summary: Supply and demand graph | Display all categories by the same values
text: Changed the supply and demand graph tooltip to list all categories that share the same values. Grouped categories are listed clearly in one tooltip.

summary: Column for Attendee Names - Team Schedule Export
text: Added a column of attendee names to the team schedule XLS export for the exhibitor's own events. The export lists attendees for events the team moderates or speaks at, after 'Participant from your side'; parents also see children's events.

summary: Favorites Dashboard - Optimize data load time
text: Sped up the Favourites dashboard with a pre-calculated table refreshed every 30 minutes and a forced 'Update' button showing the last update time. The dashboard reads pre-calculated data refreshed every 30 minutes, and admins can force a queued update of about 40 seconds.

summary: Pining interactions header in Visitor and Exhibitor Dashboards
text: Pinned the interactions table header in the visitor and exhibitor dashboards so it stays visible while scrolling. The interactions table header stays fixed while the body scrolls independently on desktop and tablet.
